name: Triumph Speed Triple 1050
engine: 1050 cc liquid-cooled inline triple, fuel injected
intro: The classic streetfighter triple. The regulator/rectifier and the clocks are the known weak spots.

add.title: Test the regulator/rectifier
add.instructions: Check battery voltage at idle and at 5,000 rpm. Look at the R/R connector for heat damage. Replace with a better unit if it is weak.
add.reason: The regulator/rectifier is a known weak spot on Speed Triples.

F: Avoid jet washing near the clocks. The 1050 clocks are known to fail.

recallNote: No recalls found for these years when this course was written. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to be sure.

known.title: Regulator/rectifier
known.what: The regulator/rectifier is a known weak spot on Speed Triples.
